shared_elements: schematic engraved/pecked linear motifs on stone surface
small repeated hook- or comma-shaped signs
justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic, reductive engraved signs — small hooked or crescent strokes and simple linear forms — which is the only real correspondence, and it is a generic one. A depicts a large horizontal boat with a row of crew strokes plus small subsidiary boats, while B depicts an anthropomorphic figure (head, torso, belt) hung with discs, hair strands and attached objects; the subjects and their organisation (horizontal vessel scene versus vertical body-centred assemblage) share nothing specific.
